name: Red Dove
summary:
Have you ever been in love? Devoted yourself to someone so entirely that you let them assist with your home, your happiness, your health? It would be quite a tragedy if they then ended up having... an ulterior motive to their kindness.

Red Dove is a short puzzle-based survival horror game focused on repetition and acting with stealth. Do too much too fast, and you’re likely to be caught by your ever-loving fiancé. Do too little too slowly, and you're sure to miss your window of opportunity for true freedom.

There is only one objective.

Escape the room before Evening Tea.
